blocks.text: Veterans of the Ozarks Suicide Prevention
To save lives and reduce suicidal behaviors by providing innovative, practical and proven suicide prevention training.
A gatekeeper is someone in a position to recognize a crisis and the warning signs that someone may be contemplating suicide.
Anyone c a n become a Gatekeeper:
Parents, friends, neighbors,teachers, ministers, doctors, nurses, office supervisors, squad leaders, foremen, police officers, advisors, caseworkers, firefighters.
